artist.name: Adam Rahman
artist.bio: Adam Rahman is an India-born techno DJ and producer based in Dubai. He was one of the early people behind Chennai's techno scene around 2000, started the Warped party series in Dubai in 2004 and runs the label KitchenSync Records. He hosted the monthly techno show WARPED on boxout.fm.

eras.sound: Trippy, groove-led techno, from downtempo to dark techno

press.title: Set Review: Indian Dubai-based Adam Rahman on Resident Advisor's Wild City Mix
